extracted.name: Grandma's Stuffed Celery
extracted.description: Anyone can make this simple, old-fashioned, and tasty appetizer of celery sticks stuffed with a cream cheese and green olive filling. The green celery and olives with red pimiento pieces look pretty on an appetizer tray, too.
ingredient_lines: 1 bunch celery - large stalks washed, trimmed, and cut into 3 sections
2 (8 ounce) packages cream cheese at room temperature
1 pinch salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Thoroughly dry each piece of celery with paper towels. Mix the cream cheese, olives, garlic, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Using a knife, spread a generous amount of cream cheese filling down the center indentation of each celery piece.
